spans.s: चोदना f. 1. Sending, directing; 2. throwing; 3. urging, inciting, inspiring; 4. a precept, a sacred commandment.

चोदित a. (f. ता) 1. Urged on, driven; 2. incited, inspired; 3. sent, directed; 4. put forward (as an argument), (pp. of चुद् q.v.)
